description: PAID $0.01 USDC. Hyperliquid ranks/equity/open perps, GMX v2 on Arbitrum/Avalanche for 0x addresses, plus dYdX v4 when a dydx1 address is supplied. Public protocol data only. Informational research — not investment advice. Returns JSON ranks, equity, and open perps across Hyperliquid and, when the address matches, GMX v2 and dYdX v4.

address.description: Wallet to profile. Format: 0x plus 40 hex characters, or a dYdX v4 address that starts with dydx1. Example: 0x85ecf584f25db6f146718b86d493e33c5af72052. Required.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].
